meta: Two hundred photos to rename by date, and doing it by hand takes all afternoon. A small program would be fast, but you can't code? Claude Code is a coding agent: describe the job in words, and it writes and runs the code.

muc.title: 200 photos to rename
muc.text: Two hundred photos need renaming by the date they were taken. By hand, it takes all afternoon. A small program would be fast, but you can't code.

muc.title: Describe it in words, it writes and runs it
muc.text: Claude Code is a coding agent, a programming assistant. You describe the job in plain words, and it writes the code, tests it, and fixes bugs on its own.

muc.title: No black screen needed
muc.text: It's in the desktop app and on the web. You don't have to use the terminal, the black screen programmers use.

muc.title: What do non-programmers do with it?
muc.text: Non-programmers use it to make small tools: rename photos in bulk, merge 12 Excel files into one, or build a simple website for a shop.

muc.title: Try it on a copy first
muc.text: Remember the rule: test on a copy of a few files first, and only run it on everything once it's right. Claude Code also asks before it changes or deletes files.

muc.title: Which plan?
muc.text: Claude Code needs a paid plan, Pro and up.

muc.title: Ten photos first
muc.text: Copy 10 photos into a separate folder, and ask Claude Code to rename them by the date taken. Once it's right, do the whole collection.

muc.title: The last tool: Claude Science
muc.text: The last tool is for one specific job: scientists. Part 9: Claude Science.
